Astro Amp Astrotone V2 Vintage Electric Guitar Fuzz Effects Pedal – Rare Original ’60s Distortion Box Version 2, Like Fuzzz Boxx FX Stompbox Add To Wishlist View Wishlist Category Effects Tags Astro Amp , Astrotone , Fuzzz Boxx , Sam Ash Share this: Description Information $ell Yours Today! – For your consideration is this vintage 1967 Universal Amplifier Corp. Astro Amp Astrotone fuzz effects pedal. – This is a very nice original example of an incredibly rare fuzz pedal. – This exact pedal is featured and discussed on the fuzzboxes.org website. Specifically, images of this unit are posted to illustrate the subtle differences between the late-’66 version 1 Astrotone, and the early-’67 version 2 Astrotone. – One corner of the phenolic board displays a chip, though it does not affect functionality or the structural integrity of the circuit board. – The 9v battery terminal has been replaced. – Please scroll through the entire gallery to view all 17 images available.
